basic_profile.bio: A digital nomad currently based in Seville, Spain. With a background in IT security, I spend my days working remotely as a cybersecurity consultant. My evenings are often spent exploring local music scenes or hiking in the Andalucian countryside. I'm a huge fan of indie bands, particularly Pup, and have been following their work for years. I'm also involved in online coding challenges to keep my skills sharp. In a long-term relationship with my partner, who travels with me. I’m typically online during European late mornings and early evenings.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in Computer Science and over a decade of experience in cybersecurity, I have honed my skills through both formal education and hands-on work in various tech companies. I am particularly adept at network security and privacy solutions, often experimenting with VPN setups and encryption protocols.
